title: The Fox in the Box
lines: Six figs sit in the box.
A red fox got in it!
The fox bit a fig. Yum!
The box tips. The fox is in.
The fox yips. Ben runs up.
Ben can fix it. Ben tips it.
The fox runs! It runs a lot.
Ben has six figs, not a fox.

questions.ask: How many figs were in the box?
questions.listenFor: Six. A number is easy to skim past, so have them find the word six on the page and touch it.

questions.ask: Why could the fox not get out?
questions.listenFor: The box tipped over with the fox inside. If they are stuck, read that line again and ask what happened to the box.

questions.ask: Do you think Ben should have let the fox out? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. Listen for a reason - the fox was stuck, or the fox was eating his figs. Both are good thinking.
